title: skewness

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host for compatibility until provider reduction hooks exist.

description: `skewness(X)` computes biased sample skewness along the first non-singleton dimension. `skewness(X,0,...)` applies the bias correction. Dimension, vector-dimension, and `"all"` forms are supported.
behaviors: Flag `1` is the default biased moment estimator.
Flag `0` applies the usual finite-sample bias correction and returns `NaN` for slices with fewer than three values.
NaNs are treated as missing and omitted from each slice by default.

faqs.question: What is the default flag?
faqs.answer: The default is `1`, the biased moment estimator used by MATLAB.
